context_for_next_testing_agent: V8 UI Overhaul fully tested. KEY CHANGES VERIFIED: (1) Sidebar renamed: 'Website Form Approval' replaces 'Website Form Management'. Nav ID: 'formapproval'. (2) Admin Management nav item only visible for superadmin role - shows System Admins (read-only) and Custom Admins with CRUD. (3) Dashboard: no duplicate rooms widget, vertical daily schedule with full words (families, people), pending notification banner with 'Review Now' button. (4) Guest List: arrival status toggle to 'Arrived' opens ArrivalRoomModal with room search, 'Already Booked' indicator for occupied rooms, and 'Mark Arrived Without Room' option. (5) Simplified filters: only arrival date, departure date, arrival status (no search, no date ranges). (6) Action buttons have text labels (View, Edit, Delete). (7) Homepage: KathaEpisodesSection now bg-[#0B1C3D]. Section order: ...Schedule→Episodes→Family→Registration→Venue. (8) Address placeholder: 'Address' not 'City, Country'. (9) Mobile UX: pulsing golden dot with 'Tap for all settings' text. MOCKED: Bulk Guest Messaging send functionality (UI scaffold only, no actual SMS/WhatsApp delivery).
